mapper.select: SELECT id, name, latitude AS lat, longitude AS lng, ST_Distance(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography)::int AS meters FROM retrip_place WHERE source = 'hangang' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography, #{meters}) ORDER BY geom <-> ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT pier_id, route, direction, run_no, time_min, is_arrival AS arrival FROM hangang_bus_time ORDER BY route, direction, run_no, time_min
